raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Results-driven Business Analyst with over 8 years of experience across Banking, Capital Markets, and Financial Services domains, driving digital transformation, process optimization, and automation initiatives. Proven expertise in Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Trade Finance, and Core Banking Solutions with hands-on Experience in Requirement Elicitation, Gap Analysis, Agile Delivery, and Stakeholder Management. Skilled in preparing BRD, FRD, User Stories, Process Flows, and Traceability Matrices to ensure alignment between business needs and technical delivery. Adept at managing end-to-end SDLC, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and conducting UAT and functional testing to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions. Proficient in JIRA, Confluence, Power BI, SQL, and API Postman, with a consistent track record of improving efficiency, enhancing user adoption, and enabling data-driven decision-making.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies
Agile & Scrum Methodologies. • Requirement Elicitation • Documentation – Proficient in preparing BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, Workflow Diagrams • User Acceptance Testing • • • Gap Analysis Stakeholder Management Change Management


Technical Tools – Hands-on experience with Power BI, SQL, API Postman, JIRA, Axure, Visio, Confluence, and Excel for analysis, prototyping, and reporting. Project & Product Management – Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile project execution, product road-mapping, sprint planning, and team coordination
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Senior Business Analyst Aston Cartan (Client:HSBC Global Banking and Markets)| May 2026 – till present


•

Support business readiness and operational readiness activities across business and technology workstreams within HSBC transformation initiatives. Coordinate with business stakeholders, operations, technology teams, and delivery leads to identify risks, dependencies, and readiness requirements. Conduct business impact assessments and support implementation planning for change initiatives. Facilitate stakeholder discussions and governance reviews to ensure alignment with programme objectives and deployment milestones. Support deployment planning, readiness validation, issue resolution, and operational transition activities.

Collaborate with testing, operations, and delivery teams to ensure successful implementation and business adoption.
Business Analyst BNY Technologies Pvt. Ltd | Nov 2023 – 2026 Project: LOS (Loan Origination System)
Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to gather, analyze, and validate
end-to-end requirements, resulting in a 35% improvement in requirement clarity and delivery speed. Conduct requirement elicitation sessions (interviews, JAD sessions, workshops) with cross-functional teams (Credit, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT), reducing requirement gaps by 30%. Create and maintain critical BA artifacts including:

• BRD and FRD for all loan processing modules, reducing functional ambiguity by 40% • Use Case Diagrams and Process Flows (Lucidchart / Draw.io) • 100+ detailed User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria in JIRA, enabling smooth sprint execution • Define and manage epics, user stories, and sprint backlog items, supporting timely delivery of 12+


sprints with 95% adherence to sprint goals. Perform gap analysis and impact assessment across modules like loan application, credit check, document upload, approval, disbursement, and closure, leading to 20% faster loan processing time. Collaborate with UI/UX teams to design 30+ intuitive wireframes and screen mockups, enhancing customer experience and reducing form abandonment by 25%.
Document API integration requirements for services like CIBIL, Aadhaar eKYC, PAN verification, and integration with Core Banking System (CBS)—resulting in 90% process automation for KYC and credit evaluation. Support data mapping and interface design with DMS and LMS, reducing manual effort by 40% and increasing data accuracy by 30%. Coordinate with QA for test case validation, UAT support, and defect triaging, contributing to 98% test coverage and successful Go-Live with zero critical issues. Present status updates, risk logs, and sprint reports to stakeholders, contributing to on-time delivery of MVP within 4 months.



Project: Application Customization & Client Delivery Optimization

Lead client workshops to elicit, analyse, and validate business requirements, ensuring seamless customization and successful end-to-end implementation of enterprise applications.
Act as the primary liaison for managing client change requests, documenting enhancements, and


prioritizing backlog items using Moscow and business value frameworks. Prepare and maintain detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD) to ensure traceability and alignment with business goals. Collaborate with development and QA teams to translate requirements into user stories, define acceptance criteria, and ensure smooth sprint execution.
Manage and track defects in JIRA, ensuring timely resolution, validated fixes, and consistent delivery
of high-quality product functionality. Conduct functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm readiness for production release, minimizing post-deployment issues. Lead triage efforts during critical production downtimes, coordinating across Technology, QA, and Professional Services teams to ensure rapid issue resolution and maintain business continuity. • Deliver client training sessions and knowledge-sharing programs to drive adoption, enhance user


experience, and maximize application value realization.
Business Analyst Credit Suisse India Pvt. Ltd | May 2021 – Oct 2023 Project: Capital Markets – Business Process Optimization & Automation

Led comprehensive requirement-gathering sessions through workshops and stakeholder interviews, ensuring accurate capture of business needs. Translated business requirements into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process flows for clear technical implementation. Performed gap and impact analysis using UML and flowcharts to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements. Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE assessments to design scalable, fit-for-business solutions aligned with organizational goals. Prioritized change requests using MoSCoW, ensuring timely delivery of high-value features. Collaborated with technical teams during Agile ceremonies to ensure sprint alignment and quality outcomes. • Executed UAT and functional testing to validate end-to-end functionality and ensure smooth go-live. • Delivered post-implementation training and support, resulting in a 15% drop in post-launch defects

Enhanced Loan Origination efficiency by 35% through optimized requirement gathering, workflow automation, and integration with credit and KYC APIs.

and DMS systems, ensuring 99% data accuracy. Streamlined Capital Markets processes, leading to a 10% reduction in documentation time and 15% decrease in post-launch defects through improved BRD and UAT practices. Improved reconciliation accuracy by 25% in Trade Finance operations by leveraging TLM tools and implementing proactive error resolution measures.
Accelerated Agile delivery by leading cross-functional teams through 12+ sprints with 95% adherence to sprint goals and improved stakeholder visibility via JIRA dashboards.
Recognized for delivering a zero-defect Go-Live for a critical LOS revamp project impacting 500K+ customer records with 99.5% migration accuracy.
